name: slaed/cms
description: SLAED CMS - Modern, Secure, High-Performance Content Management System

suggest.ext-fileinfo: Names an uploaded file by the magic database; without it the upload service falls back to its own structural validators
suggest.ext-zip: Opens an uploaded zip archive as a second proof beside the structural walk of its central directory
suggest.ext-zlib: Decompresses an uploaded gzip member to hold it against its own checksum and length
